$comment: Hullo's passenger ferry between Vancouver and Nanaimo (https://hullo.com). One route (routes.json) along berths and a lane traced from AIS (ferries/hullo.json). Terms: none published for the GTFS (DATA-LICENSES.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS #4).
name: Hullo
$timezoneChecks: Known facts about the feed's time zone that the runtime's time zone data (tzdata, via ICU) must agree with; the server refuses to start otherwise (checkTimezoneData in packages/transit-core/src/time.ts). Times are still always computed from the runtime's data, never from these. BC moved to permanent UTC-7 in 2026 (tzdata 2026b, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/NEWS); older data falls back to UTC-8 on 2026-11-01.

timezoneChecks.reason: British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (tzdata 2026b or later)

static.$comment: Linked from nowhere we found; given in issue #250 (checked 2026-11-01: version 20261020115220, 35 KB, valid 2026-01-24 to 2026-12-31). Every service is dated in calendar_dates.txt, one service_id per date, with no calendar.txt; 2,919 trips of 75 minutes with no block_id. No dated history: fetch-gtfs archives each version it sees. Whether the next timetable comes before 2026-12-31: OPEN-QUESTIONS #3.

ais.$comment: No GTFS-realtime found. Its two vessels' positions from aisstream.io (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#seabus-ais), on the server leader's one connection with the SeaBus's, recorded to var/ais-history/hullo/; the browser turns them into timetable anchors (packages/transit-core/src/ais/match.ts). With no block_id, which vessel runs which trip comes from matching. Coverage mid-strait is unknown: gaps are filled from the timetable. OPEN-QUESTIONS #5.
ais.$boundingBox: The whole crossing, both harbours with a margin, [[lat, lon], [lat, lon]] (aisstream order).
ais.$liveWindowS: As the SeaBus's: more than the day file's edge-cache time plus the browser's longest poll interval.
ais.$match: Matching fixes to trips. Guesses, looser than the SeaBus's for a long crossing along an averaged lane; tune with pipelines/eval-ais.ts --feed hullo. OPEN-QUESTIONS #5.

match.$maxOffsetM: The tracks spread ~1 km either side of the averaged lane mid-strait, one ~2.5 km (ferries/hullo.json).
match.$minTurnaroundS: Timetabled layovers are 45 minutes; a late vessel catches up by shortening them to this.

ais.$glide: As the SeaBus's (config/feeds/translink/feed.json), scaled for a vessel cruising at ~16 m/s. guess
